description: ABOUT JOHN MESSINGERPeople in government need more humility. Our courts are for everyone regardless of creed, but I believe God’s only Son had to die to pay for my sins. He doesn’t love me any more than He does the worst criminal. I’m not better than anyone whose case would come before me.Part of humility
